soups.name: Egusi Soup
soups.desc: A beloved Nigerian classic made with ground melon seeds, palm oil, leafy vegetables, and assorted meats. Its rich, hearty texture pairs beautifully with pounded yam, eba, or fufu.

soups.name: Efo Riro
soups.desc: A flavorful Yoruba vegetable stew prepared with leafy greens, red peppers, onions, locust beans, and smoked fish. It offers a satisfying balance of savory flavor and gentle heat.

soups.name: Ogbono Soup
soups.desc: This traditional draw soup gets its distinctive smooth, stretchy texture from ground wild mango seeds. Slow-cooked with stock, spices, and proteins, it is a comforting match for Nigerian swallows.

soups.name: Okra Soup
soups.desc: Fresh chopped okra gives this soup its characteristic silky texture. Combined with seafood, beef, seasonings, and aromatic stock, it makes a light but deeply satisfying meal.

soups.name: Banga Soup
soups.desc: A fragrant Niger Delta favorite made from palm fruit extract and a distinctive blend of traditional spices. Fish and meat enrich the broth, creating a bold, warming dish.

soups.name: Edikang Ikong
soups.desc: A vegetable-rich specialty associated with Efik cuisine, combining fluted pumpkin leaves and waterleaf with crayfish, stockfish, and other flavorful ingredients.

soups.name: Afang Soup
soups.desc: A cherished Efik and Ibibio dish featuring finely sliced afang leaves and tender waterleaf. Crayfish and smoked fish lend depth to this nourishing, savory soup.

soups.name: Oha Soup
soups.desc: A comforting southeastern Nigerian soup built around tender oha leaves and a cocoyam-thickened broth. Its delicate herbal flavor works especially well with fufu or pounded yam.

soups.name: Ofe Nsala
soups.desc: Often called white soup, this Igbo specialty uses a light, aromatic broth with fish, yam thickener, and distinctive local herbs. It is warming, peppery, and full of flavor.

soups.name: Bitterleaf Soup
soups.desc: Carefully washed bitterleaf adds a pleasantly earthy note to a rich, thickened broth. Cocoyam, palm oil, and traditional seasonings bring the ingredients together.

soups.name: Goat Meat Pepper Soup
soups.desc: Tender goat meat is simmered in a fragrant, peppery broth with traditional spices. This lively soup is enjoyed for its aromatic warmth and bold seasoning.

soups.name: Catfish Pepper Soup
soups.desc: Fresh catfish is gently cooked in a fragrant broth seasoned with peppers and traditional pepper-soup spices. The result is a light, warming soup with a distinctive savory taste.

soups.name: Ewedu Soup
soups.desc: A smooth Yoruba soup made from jute leaves, valued for its light, silky texture. It is commonly served alongside gbegiri and stew with amala.

soups.name: Gbegiri
soups.desc: A creamy Yoruba bean soup made from cooked and blended beans, seasoned for a smooth, savory finish. It is especially popular alongside ewedu and amala.

soups.name: Fisherman Soup
soups.desc: Inspired by the seafood traditions of Nigeria's coastal communities, this generous soup brings together fish, prawns, crab, and aromatic spices in a flavorful broth.
